calls.name: ThisDoc.Document
calls.evidence: The Advanced API Functions Reference documents ThisDoc.Document as the way to get the document in which the current rule is stored, as an Inventor.Document object, and lists iLogicVb.RuleDocument only as the older syntax.
calls.note: Documented as the current syntax and not marked deprecated or removed, though the page is from the 2026 help rather than 2027.2.
calls.query: Inventor iLogic and API reference ThisDoc.Document Inventor 2027.2

calls.name: ThisDoc.PathAndFileName
calls.evidence: The Document Functions Reference lists PathAndFileName as returning the path and file name of the document, with syntax ThisDoc.PathAndFileName(False), and does not mark it deprecated or removed.
calls.sourceQuote: Returns the path and the file name of the document.
calls.note: The documented syntax includes a boolean argument, but the call is described as available and not marked otherwise; the latest cited doc is for 2025, not 2027.2.
